dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Duel

dialogues.speaker: Patton
dialogues.text: Th—This mistake! How did this... Blast!

dialogues.speaker: Patton
dialogues.text: I won! I didn't make a mistake this time!

dialogues.speaker: Patton
dialogues.text: How can this be? This is not what I had in mind!

dialogues.speaker: Patton
dialogues.text: Haha! I got you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you have any specials these days?

dialogues.speaker: Patton
dialogues.text: Currently, we're giving every customer a free Chicken-Mushroom Skewer. It goes great with any drink!

dialogues.speaker: Patton
dialogues.text: Here, take one and have a seat. I promise it'll suit your liking!

dialogues.speaker: Patton
dialogues.text: Come in, come in! We are having a discount at Angel's Share!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about Angel's Share.

dialogues.speaker: Patton
dialogues.text: It was way back when the Dawn Winery was just established when the owner of the winery opened this tavern.

dialogues.speaker: Patton
dialogues.text: The winery's owner, Master Diluc, still holds the deed to Angel's Share. He really has taken the business to the next level.

dialogues.speaker: Patton
dialogues.text: "The best in Mondstadt" is the truth.

dialogues.speaker: Patton
dialogues.text: Master Diluc serves the customers here personally when he's in a good mood, and let Charles off for a day or two.

dialogues.speaker: Patton
dialogues.text: If you see him here, be respectful. He is Mondstadt's tycoon, you know...

choices.text: Tell me about the wine industry in Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Patton
response.text: Mondstadt's climate, water, and crops are all perfect for making wine... I have to agree, we are blessed by the Anemo Archon!

response.speaker: Patton
response.text: Apple cider and cherry ciders all taste mighty nice — I forgot to mention dandelion wine! That's one of a kind!

response.speaker: Patton
response.text: By exporting to Liyue's trade unions, Mondstadt's wines will be sold all over the continent.

response.speaker: Patton
response.text: They make incredible sales over there. Some even call it "bottled Mora."

response.speaker: Patton
response.text: This must be why Dawn Winery's owner is so filthy rich...

response.speaker: Patton
response.text: Let me give you a piece of advice... Don't touch any of the bottles here, no matter how plain it looks...

response.speaker: Patton
response.text: The bottle I broke happened to be the last owner's collector's red wine... Do you see the villa to the north over there?

response.speaker: Patton
response.text: What I mean is, that wine cost as much as that villa.

response.speaker: Patton
response.text: By my calculations, I need to work 48 more years to pay it back... without sleeping and eating.

response.speaker: Patton
response.text: Well... It doesn't seem THAT hopeless if I think about it like that.

response.speaker: Patton
response.text: I need to get back to buying back my freedom... Hahaha... *coughs* *sobs*

dialogues.speaker: Patton
dialogues.text: I'm fine, thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Patton
dialogues.text: You leaving already? If you want to try Mondstadt's best wine, this is the place!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Stormterror...

dialogues.speaker: Patton
dialogues.text: *sigh* Honestly, that scared me to death. We don't know when Stormterror might attack again, either... but even so, I have to stand here and advertise the tavern.

dialogues.speaker: Patton
dialogues.text: I do owe Master Diluc money, so much money that I'll have to stand out here without food, drink or sleep for another forty-eight years. If I slack off now, that time will get extended.

dialogues.speaker: Patton
dialogues.text: ...I wonder if Master Diluc will clear my debt on account of the dragon's attacks?

dialogues.speaker: Patton
dialogues.text: Probably not, haha... *sobs*
